# T0.16 — does a clean two-file layout (the benchmark's file holds only the loop's function) change anything but the harness?

*Generated by `agent/tools/campaign.py reports` from `results/campaign.json` and the experiment record (`agent/THESIS_EXPERIMENTS.md`). Edit those, then regenerate — not this file.*

**Status:** pre-flight

## The question

The author, 4 Oct: the file a model reads must be an ordinary code file — no note, no measurement code. Layout tested: the loop's function alone in the benchmark's file, `main` with the repetition loop and `pb_mix` in a second file no model can change, data and digest outside the package as in v4. Per `tsvc_b1` loop: identical output; DiscoPoP's view of the loop under study (candidates, Do-All set, blockers, the order statement) as in v4; the runner end to end with no model.

## Result in one paragraph

Mac prototype, 4 Oct (43 loops, no model): outputs identical 43 of 43 (two sizes, both inputs, full dump); the sequential original as fast (0.96–1.03, six loops); DiscoPoP's view the same on 34 of 43 by the recorded criteria — of the 9 that differ, 5 are the order statement (an agent defect that v4 has too: the sentence depends on which variable DiscoPoP names first for the repetition loop), 1 is by construction (s151) and 3 are DiscoPoP verdicts that are right in the new layout and wrong in v4 (s244, s481, s482; one profile each); the order statement is word for word the same on k19, k23, k31, k36; the runner works on the layout with no code change. Open before any model run: the order statement's rule, the model alone taking back one file only, four tools that open `final.c` by name; then two draws on the server.

The sequential original is as fast: timed region at STANDARD, median of 5, six loops, v5/v4 0.96–1.03. **(2) DiscoPoP's view, one profile per layout, the agent's own profiling and planning code (v5 as a project, through a unity unit):** the same on 34 of 43 for every recorded criterion (candidates with tier and pattern, the Do-All set, the blocker of the loop under study, the repetition loop blocked, the order statement); 4 more differ only in WAR/WAW records of the store line (T0.15: what two draws of one layout differ in). Of the 9: `s151` by construction (the function that held the repetition loop is one call now); `s244`, `s481`, `s482` are DiscoPoP verdicts right in v5 and wrong in v4, one profile each (`s244`: the loop's blocker is the WAW it really carries, not a RAW carried between repetitions; `s481`: v4 reports the repetition loop Do-All; `s482`: v4's profile blocks the loop on a RAW only the repetitions carry, where E2-B1's profiles of the same package reported it Do-All — candidate bug B16, which has nothing to attach to when the repetition loop is in another function); and the order statement on 5 (next row). **(3) The order statement on the hidden-order kernels** `k19`, `k23`, `k31`, `k36` (and `s211`): word for word the same. **(4) The runner end to end, no model** (`mac_v5_preflight`, `discopop_gate_v3`): `s000` — DiscoPoP's pragma placed in the clean file, verification exact on both inputs; `k19` — no change. **What changes for a model:** it cannot touch the repetition loop (no work moved in front of the repetitions, no second copy of them — Fable's harness edits and Opus's set-up before the loop are both gone); the agent's first region is the loop under study, where v4 handed it the repetition loop around it; nothing states the length of `u` and `v`. **Still to build and check before a model reads it** (the folder's README): the order statement's rule; the model alone taking back the benchmark's file only (`bare_llm.py` copies back every unit of a project); `race_check.py`, `hot_loop_coverage.py`, `routing_check.py`, `marginal_replay.py` on a project trial; `k36` (its hidden fact is two macros — code — which need a header no model can open); `vas` (a harness name in the function); the expert references in the layout; then two draws on the server, the classes (T0.11) and the sizes (T0.1) | Result, T0.16 |
